verdict.rationale: Appwrite's own docs say its managed databases come 'with permissions and realtime' and that apps can 'respond to server events in realtime', and a community comment refers to its WebSocket connection pool. So the product does ship a realtime capability. The evidence never shows the client-side subscribe workflow or confirms that UI updates on data changes without polling. Missing for 10: documented client SDK subscription API (channels/events for row changes), payload/event semantics, hands-on or independent corroboration of live UI updates.

support.subject: As a developer, I can subscribe to live data changes so my UI updates in real time without polling
